hypothesis: Left and right horns of ruminants are mirror-image spirals.
pass_criterion: After reflecting the left horn, landmark Procrustes distance to the right horn is below 5% of horn length in at least 90% of specimens.
fail_criterion: Fewer than 60% of specimens fall below 10%.
interpretation: Mirror symmetry is tested by left-right landmark asymmetry. My search found no public horn-specific 3D dataset.
no_dataset_reason: No public bovid horn dataset was found; the only horn-specific hit was an access-restricted thesis.
